title: System hangs when trying to suspend while rsync is running
body: I'm transferring a pretty significant amount of data (roughly 4 TB) through rsync. What I usually do in this case is to let the system run throughout the night while rsync does its work. However the following morning I noticed the system completely frozen with a black screen, unresponsive, and I'm left only with the option to hard reset the PC with the power button. I noticed this happens when the system tries to put itself into suspend mode. I know I could just disable suspension altogether in my case but I really wish to understand what's causing the system to crash. Here are the last lines from my journal log, from which it's clear rsync complains a lot (probably due to the network connection dropping?), but I am really not an expert of interpreting it.
